title: Sequence-Specific Structural Features and Solvation Properties of Transcription Factor Binding DNA Motifs: Insights from Molecular Dynamics Simulation.
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过原子级分子动力学模拟系统研究人类TF结合基序的序列依赖性结构特征、溶剂化与离子结合性质，直接聚焦TF-DNA互作的结构与动态机制，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Sequence-specific recognition of transcription factor (TF) binding motifs in the target site of DNA over the vast amount of non-target DNA is of primary importance for the transcriptional regulation of gene expression by the TFs. Binding of TFs to the target site of DNA relies not only on the direct contact formation but also on the structural and conformational features of DNA. Recognition of DNA structural features or shape readout by proteins is an important factor in the context of TF-DNA interaction. Based on the atomistic molecular simulation, here we report the sequence-dependent unique structural features, solvation, and ion-binding properties of biologically relevant AT- and GC-rich human TF binding motifs in DNA. Counterion and water distribution around the motif is found to be sensitive to the motif sequence, which is accompanied with the DNA shape features. The motif sequence affects the electrostatic potential along the grooves, and cytosine methylation alters the DNA shape features. Characteristic solvation properties of TF binding motif DNA fragments infer that an ionic environment and hydration influences are essential to describe TF-DNA interactions.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TF）在DNA靶位点中，于大量非靶DNA中序列特异性识别其结合基序，对于TF调控基因表达的转录过程至关重要。TF与DNA靶位点的结合不仅依赖于直接接触的形成，还取决于DNA的结构和构象特征。蛋白质对DNA结构特征或形状读出的识别，在TF-DNA相互作用的背景下是一个重要因素。基于原子级分子模拟，我们在此报告了生物相关的富含AT和GC的人类TF结合基序在DNA中序列依赖的独特结构特征、溶剂化及离子结合特性。发现基序周围的反离子和水分布对基序序列敏感，这与DNA形状特征相伴。基序序列影响沟槽内的静电势，而胞嘧啶甲基化改变DNA形状特征。TF结合基序DNA片段的特征性溶剂化性质表明，离子环境和水分影响对于描述TF-DNA相互作用至关重要。
